annotations.text:
READ THE BADGES

EXISTS = solid chip. The endpoint is already in
routes/feeds.py; this is only a reachability change.

PROPOSED = dashed amber chip. New behaviour. Nothing
here is built yet — the chip is the honest line between
"move a button" and "write a feature".

Feed names are synthetic, per the repo's no-real-feeds
rule. The counts and error strings are real: 21 failing
feeds, taken from the Miniflux log this morning.

TRIAGE — the deliverable (Main)

Nothing new invented: this is Sentry's group-by-error-
signature, dropped into the three-pane shell you already
have. Sidebar picks a cause, middle lists its feeds,
right pane holds the fix. Same muscle memory as reading.

The move that matters: 19 of your 21 failures are two
causes wearing 19 names. Fixing them one feed at a time
is the actual problem — so the remedy binds to the
group, not the row.

GONE QUIET is the odd one out, and it is the reason you
asked. feed_health.py has no concept of "publisher went
silent" — its `stale` measures time since Miniflux last
polled, while _macros.html labels it "no items 24h+".
The label promises the signal you wanted; the code
measures something else.

⌘K PALETTE (Palette)

Straight Linear/Raycast convention — click the field and
type, it filters live. Try "opml", "quiet", "lobby".

Why it earns space: every action in the ACTIONS section
already exists as an endpoint, and every one of them is
currently four clicks deep behind /feeds. j/k/o/m/s/r
stay exactly as they are; this only covers what has no
key today.

The TRIAGE section at the top is what makes it more than
a nicety — it is the same worklist as Main, reachable
without leaving the article you are reading.

ALTERNATIVE — /feeds restyled (FeedsPage)

The conservative option: no new view. Keep triage where
the bulk actions already live, and fix what is wrong
with that page — it is still Tailwind-generic while the
reader is dense and dark, the bulk bar is display:none
until you tick a box, and "health" is one dropdown
among four.

Here the health dropdown becomes cause chips, the bulk
bar is always visible (dimmed when nothing is selected),
and the row shows its cause instead of hiding the error
in a title attribute.

TRADEOFF: cheaper, and it fixes a page that is already
below the bar — but it is a detour out of the reader,
and there is nowhere to put the per-cause explanation
and ordered remedies that Main gives you.

These two are not exclusive. This page wants this work
regardless; Main is the question.
